context: Sho-young asks Hiroshi-elder about life long ago.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、昔って、電気あったの?
lines.en: Grandpa, was there electricity in the old days?
lines.style: curious child boy voice, soft warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おう、でも、かつては少なかったで。
lines.en: Yeah, but back then there was less of it.
lines.style: slow elder Kansai voice, warm reminiscent delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Whoa — was it dark at night?
lines.style: awed child boy voice, soft warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 電気の灯り、少なくてな、星がよう見えた。
lines.en: There were few lights, so you could really see the stars.
lines.style: gentle elder Kansai voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: That sounds nice — I'd love to see that!
lines.style: bright child boy voice, soft warm cheerful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いつか、田舎で見せたるわ。
lines.en: Someday I'll show you out in the countryside.
lines.style: tender elder Kansai voice, soft warm fond delivery carefully
